title: Remote Real Estate Bookkeeper (Part-Time)
description:
REMOTE REAL ESTATE BOOKKEEPER (PART-TIME) - US COMPANY, WORK FROM THE PHILIPPINES



Cash Now Philly | Fully Remote | Part-Time, ~20 hrs/week | Reports to the CFO



=====================================



FIRST, IS THIS YOU?



You feel a small, real satisfaction when every account reconciles to the penny and the last uncategorized transaction disappears. An empty queue is a good feeling. A clean close is a good day.



You treat other people's money like it is under a microscope, because to you it is. You would rather raise an uncomfortable question than let a number sit wrong. You do not cut corners, not even the ones nobody would ever catch.



You are experienced, you manage yourself, and you bring your own systems instead of waiting to be told every step. If that is you, keep reading. This was built for you.



=====================================



THIS IS NOT FOR EVERYONE



Please do not apply if:



- You save your work for month-end instead of staying current every day

- You go quiet when you are confused instead of asking

- You need someone checking behind you

- Close enough feels fine to you



We are not being harsh. We respect your time and ours. The right person just felt more interested, not less.



=====================================



WHO WE ARE



Cash Now Philly is the leading family-owned cash home buyer in Greater Philadelphia, in business since 2017, more than 600 homes purchased, A+ with the BBB. We run three companies, we have a CFO, a weekly bookkeeping cadence, and real systems. This is a serious operation, and your work here will be treated as serious. Your talent will not be wasted.



We want A-plus work and A-players only.



=====================================



THE BOOKS YOU WOULD OWN



You would be our only bookkeeper, owning four connected sets of books:



1. Cash Now Philly (wholesale)

2. Off Market Equity (fix and flip)

3. Coffee House Holdings (rentals)

4. Owner's personal books (connected to all three through owner draws, contributions, and transfers between the companies)



=====================================



WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU



- Ownership. You run the entire finance back office, not a slice of it. It is yours.

- Trust, not supervision. You are trusted to run it your way, not watched. Nobody chases you, because you do not need chasing.

- Mastery. Four entities and real intercompany work will make you a sharper bookkeeper than a single-company seat ever could.

- Visibility. Your accuracy is seen at the top. The CFO and the owner know your name and your numbers.

- Real support. A weekly bookkeeping meeting to ask questions directly, a dedicated accounting Slack channel, and AI tools to help you name and categorize transactions fast. You are never left guessing.

- Quiet, focused work. Heads-down, no meetings all day, no rallying a team. Your focus is the point.



=====================================



WHAT YOU WOULD DO



- Record and categorize every transaction across all four books daily, coded to the correct company and account. All G&A, all COGS, all labor and commissions, all marketing.

- Reconcile every account to zero every month across all entities, and keep intercompany and owner flows tied out across the books.

- Enter all bills and invoices and flag due dates to the CFO. You prepare and enter. You do not move money. The CFO approves and pays.

- Track accounts receivable and report weekly.

- Close all four books by the fifth business day and deliver clean P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow reports for each company.

- Submit Ask My Accountant items for anything unresolved.

- Keep the books IRS-audit-proof at all times, every transaction documented and traceable.

- Bring and document your systems so the process is repeatable, and improve what exists.



=====================================



WHO YOU ARE



- Experienced bookkeeper for a US real estate company, across wholesale, fix-and-flip, and rentals

- QuickBooks Online expert, ProAdvisor certification preferred

- Confident with multi-entity books, intercompany transactions, owner draws, and depreciation

- Strong, clear written English

- Honest, precise, and self-managed, the kind of person who owns a clean set of books without being managed



=====================================



THE DETAILS



- Fully remote, work from anywhere in the Philippines

- Hours: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 1 PM US Eastern, which is 9 PM to 1 AM Philippine time. Four focused evening hours, then your day is your own. This is a night-shift role. Apply only if those hours work for you long term.

- Pay: $10 at 20 hours per week.

- Growth: This starts part-time. For the right person, as our companies grow, the hours and scope can grow too. We would rather grow with someone great than keep re-hiring.

- Reports to the CFO



=====================================



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word RECONCILED so we know you read this carefully.



Then send your resume and short answers to three questions:



1. Describe your hands-on QuickBooks Online experience with a US real estate company.

2. In three sentences, describe how you run a monthly close for multiple entities.

3. Tell us about a reconciliation or categorization error you caught before anyone else noticed, and how you found it.



Strong candidates get a short call with our CFO and a brief, practical QuickBooks exercise: a few real transaction types to categorize and a small set of records to reconcile. It mirrors the actual work. We move fast and we respect your time.



Send your application to

IT Support Engineer (MSP)
description:
IT Support Engineer (MSP) – Remote | Ownership, Not Tickets



Location: Remote

Type: Part-time (20 hours/week to start) with potential to grow to full-time

Hours: 10am–2pm UK

Pay: £6 per hour



About the Role:

This isn’t a typical IT support position. You won’t be stuck in a helpdesk queue, passing tickets, or limited to a narrow task list. Instead, you’ll take full ownership of multiple IT environments, solving problems end-to-end and proactively improving systems. We’re looking for someone who asks, “How can this be better?” rather than “That’s not my job.”



Key Responsibilities:

Administer, troubleshoot, and optimize Microsoft 365 (Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID)

Support Windows desktops and basic server environments

Manage networking tasks: DNS, DHCP, VPNs, Wi-Fi, and firewalls

Implement cybersecurity improvements and best practices

Assist with onboarding new users and migrations

Communicate directly with users in plain English, not IT jargon

Proactively review systems, identify gaps, and improve environments even when things are quiet



What We’re Looking For:

A well-rounded IT professional comfortable across the full IT stack

Someone who solves problems fully and takes ownership until resolved

Strong understanding that security is part of everything

Ability to work independently, troubleshoot complex issues, and figure things out

Proactive mindset during downtime; reviewing, optimizing, and improving systems



Required Skills & Experience:

Previous experience in IT support or MSP environments

Strong Microsoft 365 knowledge (essential)

Experience with Entra ID & Intune

Solid Windows desktop and basic server support

Strong networking fundamentals

Excellent problem-solving and communication skills with non-technical users



Nice-to-Have (Bonuses):

Google Workspace experience

macOS knowledge

Cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., Cyber Essentials)

Backup and disaster recovery experience

RMM/PSA tool experience



Hours & Growth:

Start with 20 hours per week (10am–2pm UK)

Opportunity to increase to full-time as the role grows

Long-term role with strong progression potential



Requirements (Non-Negotiable):

Modern, serviceable computer (e.g., Windows 11, i5+, 16GB RAM minimum)

Stable, high-speed internet connection

Secure, dedicated workspace

Applicants must provide PC specs and an internet speed screenshot



Why You’ll Love This Role:

Varied and challenging work; no two days are the same

Real autonomy and ownership

Opportunity to impact IT systems directly and improve efficiency

Exposure to business decisions and technology projects

A role where your input matters, not just following scripts



What This Role Isn’t:

Not a call center

Not a “stick to your lane” job

Not a role where you hide behind tickets



How to Apply:

Use “Vixa Hire” in the subject line of your application.

Send your resume and cover letter.

Include your internet speed test result and a screenshot of your laptop specs.

We look forward to receiving your application.

We are on the lookout for an experienced individual with a comprehensive background in M&A, FP&A and accounting. Financial Modelling

Instrument & Analyze KPIs

 what gets posted and why, you brief Thuy on exactly what to film so she can just show up and record, and you direct our editors on what videos need to get it made. Content strategy & calendar across Instagram, TikTok and YouTube for both brands — each platform run to its own best practice, not one strategy copy-pasted three ways.

 & creating newsletters with good copy

) updated with shoppable recommendations, and affiliate links accurate across platforms.

 which deals).

A live content calendar and queue across all platforms with months of briefs ahead of schedule, a healthy b-roll library with gaps flagged early, steady weekly output through AdClips (plus your own fast-turnaround trend edits), filming briefs Thuy can shoot from with zero back-and-forth, a monthly performance report, and measurable movement on the numbers that matter — follower growth, reach, saves/shares and
 sign-ups driven from content.

2+ years managing content and at least one person or agency/freelancer — briefing, reviewing, holding deadlines. This is a management role, not a solo content role.

 and recommend long-term improvements

title: Full-Time Video Editor for Short-Form and Long-Form Content (Long-Term Role)
description:
We are a content creator and licensed private investigator brand producing daily video content across multiple niche services. We are hiring one full-time video editor for a long-term role. This position is for one dedicated person only. We are not looking for agencies or multiple contractors.



You will edit short-form vertical videos for YouTube Shorts,
, TikTok, Instagram Reels, Threads, and Pinterest. Short-form content is produced daily across our niches using raw footage we provide. Your work will include adding burned-in captions, hook text, emojis where appropriate, light sound effects, and clean transitions. Edits should be fast-paced, clear, and focused on attention retention without being overproduced.



You will also edit long-form horizontal videos for YouTube and
. This includes trimming raw footage, cleaning audio, adding light B-roll, on-screen callouts, and subtle zooms. For long-form content, we will either provide the YouTube title, description, and thumbnail, or supply them in a Google Doc for you to use. You will upload finished long-form videos to the correct YouTube channels and
 pages for each niche.



All files are organized in Google Drive using a clear folder system, naming rules, and templates. You will download raw footage from Drive, upload finished edits back to Drive, and schedule short-form videos through Buffer using the provided descriptions, hooks, and hashtags. CapCut is preferred, but Adobe Premiere, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve are also acceptable.



This is a high-volume but structured role with clear instructions and repeatable workflows. Short-form editing is daily, and long-form videos are assigned in organized batches. This is a full-time, ongoing position. We value consistency, reliability, and organization more than flashy effects.



You should have proven experience editing short-form vertical content for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Strong English comprehension is required for captions and hooks. You must be highly organized, able to manage bulk content, and able to follow instructions exactly. A reliable internet connection and consistent availability are required. Availability during U.S. business hours is preferred.



Turnaround expectations are same day or next day for short-form edits and two to three days per batch for long-form videos.



To apply, please include examples of short-form videos you have edited, any long-form YouTube examples, the editing software you use, your weekly availability, and confirmation that you are seeking a long-term, full-time role.

title: Meta Ads Video Editor (Ai Proficient)

**Quick Summary**

**Daily Output:** 3–4 concepts per day (with revisions)

**Focus:** High-converting product ads using a mix of AI-enhanced and traditional editing workflows

**Location:** Remote

We are looking for a high-level AI Video Editor / Creative who understands direct response advertising, premium product cinematography, and fast-paced content production.

While AI-generated b-roll and AI workflows will be used at the start to increase speed and scale, our long-term expectation is that concepts will typically contain only around 10–20% AI-generated footage, with the remaining majority being traditional high-quality b-roll, stock integration, motion graphics, editing, and polished ad creative techniques.



We expect 3–4 strong concepts per day, including revisions and iteration based on feedback. Speed matters, but realism, conversion quality, pacing, and attention to detail matter more.

Work heavily with real footage, stock footage, motion design, pacing, transitions, subtitles, sound design, and conversion-focused editing techniques to create polished final ads.



### AI Character & Voice Integration



Create and manage realistic AI talking characters, lip-syncing, voiceovers, and emotional delivery when required.



### End-to-End Post Production



Handle scripting support, prompting, editing, upscaling, sound design, color grading, pacing, revisions, and final export delivery.



## Required Technical Stack



You should already be highly experienced with most of the following tools:



### AI Video Generation



* Runway Gen-3 / Gen-4

* Kling

* Luma Dream Machine



### Voice / Character Tools



* HeyGen

* ElevenLabs

* D-ID

* Midjourney v6+

### Editing & Post Production



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* CapCut Desktop



### AI Enhancement



* Topaz Video AI



## Requirements



### Speed & Efficiency



You must be capable of turning concepts into polished deliverables quickly while maintaining quality and realism.



### Understanding of Advertising



You should understand engaging shots, pacing, hooks, retention editing, emotional storytelling, and what makes ads convert.



### Attention to Detail



You must be able to identify and fix bad AI outputs, unrealistic movement, awkward lip-syncing, poor lighting, incorrect accents, unnatural emotion, or low-quality visual details.

Do not apply if you cannot clearly distinguish between British and American accents, create emotionally accurate AI voiceovers, or direct voice delivery properly.

description:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours (25 hours per week required)

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $350 to $500 USD a month ($4,200 - $6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)

title: BIM Modeler - Revit Families
description:
Company: RD Studio (rdstudio.co)

Employment Type: Full-Time Freelance

Location: Remote (Targeting APAC / Southeast Asia)



RD Studio is an international BIM content company known for high-quality Revit families used by thousands of architects worldwide. We are expanding our team and looking for a Revit Family Modeler who specializes in complex, highly parametric content.



** Note **

We are specifically looking for advanced modelers. If you are a beginner or only build basic geometry without nested parameters, this role is not for you).





** What You’ll Do **

- Create professional, lightweight Revit families from scratch using nested families, complex formulas, and advanced constraints.

- Maintain strict quality: Follow our internal BIM standards for geometry, parameters, materials, and visibility.

- Draft diverse assets: Work on furniture, plumbing fixtures, lighting, electrical, structural, and more.

- Collaborate efficiently: Manage your workflow using Asana, Google Sheets, and shared QA checklists.



*** What We’re Looking For ***

- Advanced Parametric Experience: Proven ability to build highly flexible families (portfolio and .RFA samples are required).

- Technical Mastery: Deep understanding of shared parameters, reference planes, type catalogs, and mathematical/logical formulas.

- Professional Organization: Ability to structure and name parameters cleanly and logically.

- Work Ethic: Strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and comfortable with English documentation.

- Bonus: Experience modeling MEP or Structural content.





**** Why Join Us? ****

100% Remote: Work from home with flexible hours.

Skill Growth: Get consistent feedback from industry experts to elevate your BIM skills.

Career Progression: Long-term collaboration with the potential to grow into a Senior Modeler or QA Leadership role.





**** Location & Budget ***

This full-time freelance position is targeted toward candidates based in Southeast Asia (Philippines, Thailand, Myanmar, etc.), as our budget is benchmarked to competitive full-time freelance rates in these regions.





***** How to Apply *****

Send an
 to 

Subject: Revit Family Modeler — [Your Name]





Please include:

1. A short introduction about your experience with complex parametric modeling.

2. Your portfolio (PDF or link).

3. At least 5 sample Revit families (.RFA format) demonstrating your highest level of parametric complexity.

4. Your current availability for full-time work.

title: Virtual Sales Manager
description:
JVDB Studios | Amsterdam, Netherlands



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Monday to Friday

Hours: 20 hours per week to start (Part-Time) with the opportunity to scale to 40 hours per week based on performance

Time Zone: Must have overlap with European/CET business hours

Compensation: Competitive base salary + uncapped commission



About JVDB Studios



JVDB Studios is a media and technology company based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. We are the team behind some of the world's largest creator brands, including Kwebbelkop and BlooGaming, which collectively reach more than 15 million subscribers globally.



Our CEO has built multiple successful digital businesses, generated billions of views across platforms, and continues to expand into new ventures within content, technology, licensing, and media distribution.



We are looking for a highly driven Senior Sales Manager / Commercial Lead who can take ownership of revenue-generating relationships across the business and work directly with the CEO to drive growth.



The Opportunity



This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for a proven closer who can build opportunities from scratch, develop relationships with decision-makers, and personally close deals.



You will own the full sales cycle across multiple business lines and play a key role in helping scale the company internationally. This role begins as a part-time position at 20 hours per week. Candidates who demonstrate strong execution, ownership, and the ability to consistently generate and close opportunities will have the opportunity to transition into a full-time role at 40 hours per week.



We believe in rewarding results. As you help grow the business, the role will grow alongside you.

ABOUT US

=====================
Canada Inc. runs two business divisions: Cost Hero Sourcing, a B2B sourcing and supply chain company that helps global clients manage vendors and logistics; and Always With Us, a direct-to-consumer e-commerce brand that sells memorial products. Together, we combine supply chain know-how with DTC brand building and marketing.



=====================

THE POSITION

=====================



The three things we care about most are strong communication, personality fit, and real problem-solving skills. The ideal Sales & Marketing Coordinator is a positive, optimistic self-starter with ideas of their own: someone who spots opportunities, brings suggestions to the table, and gets things done without needing daily direction.



To be clear about the environment: we are a small, senior leadership team that sets strategy. You will be our hands-on sales and marketing doer. There is no big marketing department around you, so you must be comfortable working independently, making day-to-day decisions yourself (for example, d
 what goes out on social rather than asking for sign-off on every post), and following through from start to finish. If you prefer detailed daily instructions or constant feedback loops, this role will not be a fit. If you love owning your lane and figuring things out, you will thrive here.



You should be comfortable with marketing tools, analytics platforms, and AI tools. We expect AI to be used as an operational tool to work faster, not as a substitute for your own thinking, writing, or problem-solving.

Follow up on inbound wholesale orders and marketplace activity, manage lead pipelines, and support relationship-building efforts that drive revenue.

s and newsletters, and keeping contact data and workflows clean.

title: Podcast Video Editor (Ongoing – 1–2 Videos Per Week)
description:
Podcast Video Editor — Ongoing Work, 1–2 Episodes Per Week



We are looking for a reliable and skilled podcast video editor for ongoing weekly work.



The role involves editing 1–2 long-form video podcasts per week and delivering polished, engaging episodes ready for YouTube.



This is not just a basic cut-and-export role. We are looking for someone who understands storytelling, pacing, audio quality, viewer retention, and how to turn a long conversation into a professional finished podcast.



Main Responsibilities



Full Podcast Edit



Each episode will usually involve:



* Editing a long-form video podcast

* Removing mistakes, repeated sections and unnecessary footage

* Tightening long pauses and dead space

* Reducing unnecessary filler words such as “ums” and “ahs” where they disrupt the flow

* Keeping the conversation natural rather than over-editing every sentence

* Improving pacing and viewer retention

* Using appropriate cuts, speaker changes and subtle zooms where needed

* Adding supplied graphics, images or B-roll where appropriate

* Exporting the final episode in the required format, ready for upload



Podcast Intro



Each episode must include an engaging intro at the beginning of the podcast.



The intro should generally be between 45 seconds and 1 minute 30 seconds and should:



* Give viewers a strong glimpse into what the episode is about

* Use some of the best or most interesting quotes from both the host and guest

* Build curiosity and encourage viewers to continue watching

* Include suitable B-roll clips, graphics or supporting visuals

* Use good pacing, music and sound design where appropriate

* Avoid giving away the entire episode

* Feel like a polished podcast trailer rather than a random collection of clips



The editor should be able to identify the strongest 
nts from the episode and arrange them into an intro that feels clear, exciting and relevant to the main topic.



Sponsor Ad Placement



Each completed podcast will include three supplied sponsor advertisements.



The editor will need to place the ads at suitable points throughout the episode using the following general structure:



* Sponsor Ad 1: Between approximately 7 and 12 minutes

* Sponsor Ad 2: Approximately 8 minutes after the first sponsor ad

* Sponsor Ad 3: Approximately 7 to 12 minutes after the second sponsor ad



These times are guidelines rather than exact requirements.



The most important requirement is that every sponsor ad is inserted at a natural break in the conversation.



Ads should be placed:



* After a topic or answer has naturally concluded

* During a clear transition between subjects

* At a 
nt where the break feels smooth and intentional

* Without cutting someone off halfway through a sentence or answer

* Without interrupting an emotional, important or fast-moving section of the discussion



The editor should use good judgement to find the closest natural break point while still keeping the ads reasonably spaced throughout the episode.



Audio Quality



Audio quality is one of the most important parts of this role.



The editor must be able to:



* Clean and improve dialogue audio

* Balance the volume of all speakers

* Make sure one speaker is not noticeably louder or quieter than another

* Reduce unwanted background noise where possible

* Remove distracting clicks, harsh breaths or unnecessary mouth sounds where appropriate

* Keep voices clear, natural and consistent

* Ensure music and B-roll audio never overpower the conversation

* Check the full episode for sudden changes in volume or audio quality



A podcast with strong visuals but poor audio will not be considered a completed professional edit.



Communication and Reliability



Consistent communication is essential.



The successful editor must be willing to communicate regularly through Signal or
.



We are looking for someone who:



* Responds consistently

* Provides progress updates

* Communicates early if there is a problem or delay

* Asks questions when instructions are unclear

* Is open to feedback and revisions

* Can meet agreed deadlines

title: YouTube Script Writer (Mystery / Paranormal / Documentary)
description:
I'm looking for a talented long-form YouTube script writer for a large YouTube channel.



I'm looking for someone who genuinely enjoys researching and writing about mysteries, unexplained events, paranormal stories, strange disappearances, cryptids, haunted locations, historical mysteries, government mysteries, strange phenomena, and other intriguing real-world stories.



Think along the lines of:



MrBallen (mystery-focused episodes)

What Lurks Beneath

Dark historical mysteries

Ghost ships

Unexplained sightings

Lost expeditions

Creepy locations

Urban legends with historical research



Not interested in:



Graphic gore

Shock content

True crime murders

Cheap clickbait

Low-effort AI-generated writing



I want scripts that feel like they were written by someone who actually became fascinated with the story.



The ideal writer naturally goes down research rabbit holes and enjoys uncovering interesting details that make viewers think:



"Wait... that's actually really strange."



Scripts should feel cinematic, well-paced, and emotionally engaging—not like a Wikipedia article.



What You'll Be Writing

Approximately 4,000 - 6,000 words per script

Strong hook

Excellent pacing

Documentary storytelling style

Clean English

Fact-checked where appropriate

Entertaining while remaining grounded



Quality matters much more than speed.



I'd rather receive one excellent script than several average ones.



Pay



$50 USD per approved script. 



Potential for long-term work if we're a good fit.



To Apply



Please include:



The word BLUEBERRY in the subject heading of your message. 

A short introduction about yourself.

Why you think you'd be a good fit for this role.

Any experience writing YouTube scripts, documentaries, horror, mystery, or long-form content.

A sample of your work. Ideally a complete script around 4,000 - 6,000 words in the mystery, paranormal, documentary, or unexplained genre.



If you don't have a script in this exact genre, send the closest example you have.

title: Part-time Online Math Tutor (Work From Home!)
description:
Brighterly is a dynamic EdTech startup on a mission to transform how children learn and love math. We provide a world-class after-school math excellence program for students from kindergarten to grade 8 in the USA.

description:
Sales Operations & CRM Specialist

HUMPIN HIPPIES | HH Brands LLC



ABOUT US



Humpin Hippies (HH Brands LLC) is a fast-growing wholesale wellness brand with a retro-hippie spirit, known for THC-free, vegan, USA-made enhancement gummies (and soon, enhancement honey). We sell B2B into smoke shops, vape shops, convenience stores, adult stores, and an active distributor network across the country.



We will not spoon-feed you — you'll get goals and context, not step-by-step hand-holding. Every report and pipeline update is reviewed; low-effort or sloppy work will NOT be accepted. Performance is tracked against clear KPIs — if accuracy and follow-through aren't there, you will be cut from the team.



THE ROLE



Keep our GoHighLevel pipeline clean, current, and working for the sales team. You'll be the person who makes sure no lead falls through the cracks — tracking stages, flagging overdue follow-ups, and surfacing the hottest opportunities every single day. We need someone detail-obsessed who can own this without being chased.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Review active opportunities in GoHighLevel and keep lead stages accurate and current.

- Confirm every qualified lead has a clear next action and owner.

- Flag overdue calls,
s, quotes, and follow-ups.

- Route and assign new leads (LinkedIn,
, website, social, research) per company procedure.

- Merge/remove duplicate CRM records and correct incomplete contact info.

- Track free boxes, samples, quotes, invoices, and proposals through to close.

- Identify customers nearing reorder windows and those who've gone quiet.

- Build a daily hot-lead list; close out or categorize unqualified opportunities; monitor pipeline aging.

- Coordinate with outreach specialists on neglected accounts and prepare the weekly pipeline report.



WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER EACH WEEK



- Fully updated CRM pipeline.

- Daily hot-lead report and overdue-follow-up report.

- Reorder-opportunity and inactive-customer reports.

- Pipeline-stage summary and list of records needing management review.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Prior CRM experience (GoHighLevel a strong plus) — proof of work is mandatory, no exceptions.

- Sharp attention to detail and comfort with repetitive data hygiene work.

- Strong organizational skills; able to juggle many open threads at once.

- Clear written communication for notes, tags, and reporting.

- Self-directed and accountable to KPIs — low-effort work and missed follow-ups will not be tolerated.



WHY JOIN HUMPIN HIPPIES



- Lean, founder-led brand with real growth and direct communication.

- Clear weekly goals — you'll always know what winning looks like.

- Long-term opportunity as we scale nationally.



HOW TO APPLY



Do NOT apply through OLJ. To apply, send us a message via WhatsApp:

/
— applications without a completed exam will not be considered.

**Please only apply if you have Amazon FBA Logistics, in the United Kingdom**



We are a UK-based Amazon FBA business selling home and kitchen products on Amazon UK. We're looking for an experienced Logistics & Supplier Coordinator to own the day-to-day communication between our team, our suppliers in China, and our freight forwarders.



This is a part-time role (approx. 20 hours/week) with the clear intention of growing into full-time as we scale. You'll work directly with our operations lead and take real ownership, not just tick boxes.



What you'll do:



- Manage daily
 and WeChat/WhatsApp communication with our China-based suppliers: purchase order confirmations, production updates, sample requests and issue resolution.

Reliable internet and availability with at least 3 hours' overlap with UK business hours

title: Campaign Operations and Logistics Coordinator
description:
Position Summary



The Campaign Operations and Logistics Coordinator is responsible for monitoring the daily delivery and inventory activities associated with customer campaigns. The role ensures that campaign orders are dispatched, transported, received, and fulfilled according to schedule while maintaining accurate visibility of stock availability by product and SKU.



The coordinator works closely with suppliers, warehouses, third-party logistics providers, transport partners, customer contacts, and internal campaign teams to identify risks, resolve missing information, and escalate delivery or inventory issues before they affect campaign execution.



Key Responsibilities



Delivery Tracking and Coordination*



Review all planned campaign deliveries daily.

Confirm the status of each delivery, including booked, dispatched, in transit, delivered, delayed, or awaiting confirmation.

Verify supplier dispatch dates and shipping documentation.

Confirm that transport has been booked and assigned.

Check customer warehouse booking dates and delivery slots.

Monitor estimated arrival times and identify deliveries at risk of missing scheduled slots.

Confirm warehouse or third-party logistics receipt of delivered and inbound goods.

Obtain proof of delivery or warehouse receipt confirmation when required.

Record the current status, risks, responsible contact, and next action for every delivery.

Follow up with suppliers, transport providers, warehouses, and customers regarding missing or conflicting information.



Inventory Monitoring*



Review daily stock levels for all campaign products and SKUs.

Monitor available, reserved, inbound, blocked, damaged, quarantined, and unavailable inventory.

Compare available and incoming inventory against open orders and planned deliveries.

Confirm that reserved inventory is allocated to the correct customer orders.

Track inbound stock quantities and expected arrival dates.

Verify that warehouse or third-party logistics inventory records are current.

Investigate discrepancies between system inventory and warehouse-confirmed stock.

Determine whether upcoming deliveries can be fulfilled using available or confirmed inbound inventory.

Identify and escalate potential shortages before they affect fulfilment.



Risk Management and Escalation*



Classify delivery and inventory activities as on track, at risk, blocked, or missing information.

Escalate issues on the same day when delivery, booking, dispatch, transport, warehouse receipt, or stock availability is unclear.

Raise delivery risks when transport is not booked, dispatch dates are unconfirmed, warehouse slots are missing, or delivery timing is at risk.

Raise inventory risks when available stock is insufficient, inbound stock is delayed, reserved quantities do not match demand, or stock is blocked or damaged.

Coordinate corrective actions with the appropriate supplier, warehouse, transport provider, customer, or internal owner.

Maintain clear ownership and target completion dates for unresolved actions.



Reporting and Task Management*



Maintain accurate campaign delivery and inventory trackers.

Update campaign tasks and follow-up actions in Asana or another designated project management system.

Prepare a daily end-of-day logistics update covering:

Deliveries reviewed

Inventory and SKUs checked

On-track deliveries

Delayed or at-risk deliveries

Stock shortages or discrepancies

Missing confirmations or information

Escalations completed

Outstanding actions and priorities for the following day

Provide campaign stakeholders with timely and accurate operational updates.

Maintain organized records of communications, confirmations, risks, and resolutions.



Required Qualifications

Previous experience in logistics coordination, supply chain operations, inventory management, order fulfilment, campaign operations, or a related field.

Experience working with suppliers, warehouses, transport providers, or third-party logistics partners.

Strong understanding of delivery tracking, warehouse bookings, inventory allocation, and order fulfilment processes.

Ability to review operational information and identify risks, inconsistencies, and missing confirmations.

Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage multiple orders, products, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

High level of accuracy and attention to detail.

Proficiency in spreadsheets, project management platforms, and inventory or order management systems.

Ability to work independently and escalate urgent issues appropriately.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting customer campaigns, retail promotions, product launches, or time-sensitive fulfilment activities.

Familiarity with Asana or a similar task management platform.

Experience working with warehouse management, transport management, enterprise resource planning, or inventory management systems.

Knowledge of proof-of-delivery processes, customer warehouse booking requirements, and third-party logistics operations.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Level Up is looking for someone who will keep the day-to-day operations running smoothly — orders logged right, the website accurate, retail compliance airtight, and customers looked after quickly and warmly — across every channel we sell: Shopify DTC, Amazon, Nordstrom, Macy’s, and our corporate gifting line. You’ll report to Michelle, who leads our operations team; inventory, production, and fulfillment sit with her, so you can stay focused on the order, compliance, and customer-support side. It’s a hands-on role, built for someone detail-obsessed who takes real pride in careful, reliable follow-through — and who thinks. We want someone who notices when something looks off and says so, not someone who just moves work through. On the customer side, you’ll use AI to help with the wording where we can, and handle it directly

where we can’t yet — so what matters most is your speed, your judgment, and your follow-through.



Key Responsibilities:

Order processing — log every order clean across DTC, Amazon, and retail into Shopify, and catch the price / MOQ / wrong-address error before it ships. You’ll also process B2B corporate- gifting orders and distributor POs as they come in.

Customer service — a big part of the role: follow up with customers fast and reliably, process warranty replacements and returns end to end (verify the window and known-batch rules, log the claim, send the confirmation), handle stuck-shipment carrier claims, and keep review-count tracking current. You’ll lean on AI to help with the brand-voice wording, so you can move fast without being a copywriter.

Website & PDP QA — upload and audit product pages across our own site and retailer portals: confirm photos are up, prices are right, and copy is correct; self-check every change and follow-up with Systems or the retailer on any questions.

System tickets & follow-through — stay on top of open system and website tickets daily, not just once a week, and chase each one to resolution so nothing slips through the cracks.

Retail routing support — fill the routing-guide / EDI forms for Nordstrom and Macy’s by following Michelle’s SOPs. This supports Michelle — careful form-filling, not deep EDI work.

Ops support & admin — the smaller pieces that keep things running: update the partner inventory (ATS) spreadsheet, keep the team calendar current, and handle IT onboarding/offboarding (setting up accounts and access by SOP — not IT troubleshooting).

Systems & SOPs — keep one source of truth, and document every process into a short SOP so the operation never lives in one person’s head.

AI & tooling (evolving) — use AI to speed up drafting and the repetitive steps where it helps. These workflows are still being built, so expect it more hands-on for now, and you’ll help shape what’s worth automating.



Qualifications:

Nothing slips past you — that’s the #1 thing. Every order, ticket, and customer note done right, and you catch the error before it goes out.

3+ years in ecommerce/retail operations, order management, or customer support — DTC + marketplace (Amazon) + wholesale/retail exposure ideal.

Hands-on in Shopify for order management, and comfortable following forms and checklists (like retail routing guides) — no deep EDI expertise needed, just care and accuracy.

Detail-obsessed and checklist-driven — you’d rather double-check than walk something back.

Reliable, warm customer follow-up — you respond fast and never let a customer thread go cold. You don’t need to be a polished writer — AI helps with the wording — but you can hold a customer conversation on your own, too.

Calm under volume; comfortable in async, remote, founder-led environments, with meaningful overlap with US business hours.

Comfortable with AI — you use it to work faster where you can, and you’re happy to roll up your sleeves manually while we build those workflows out.

Here for the long haul — someone who wants to own this work and get great at it, not use it as a stepping stone to the next thing.



What separates great from good

Owns their lane and keeps it running clean.

Catches the error before it goes out, instead of cleaning it up later.

Documents as they go, so nothing lives in one person’s head.

Uses good judgment on the details, and raises the bigger calls early.

Steady when things get busy — holiday and gifting season don’t rattle them.



How we work together

Regular weekly ops meetings with Michelle (ops lead) and the CEO — priorities, what’s shipping, and what’s at risk.

Quarterly planning — themes, major 
nts (holiday, gifting season), and KPI targets.

Async-first via Slack — decisions documented, same-day response on blockers.



How to apply

Start your application with the word CLEAN, and in three sentences tell us about a time you caught an order, inventory, or shipping error before it went out the door — something no one flagged for you. Applications that skip this won’t be read.

title: Online Booking Agent – Flexible Part-Time, Performance Pay
description:
Job Title: Online Booking Agent (Part-Time, Pay Per Booking)



## About the Job



We run a service that helps clients secure visa appointment slots at consulates/embassies. Appointment slots on the official visa portals open at specific times and get taken within minutes — your job is to be logged in, ready, and fast.



We are hiring a few reliable, detail-oriented people for this role. This is simple but high-focus work: no cold calling, no selling, no content writing. You just need to be sharp, punctual, and quick with a mouse and keyboard.



## What You Will Do



- Log in to the official visa appointment portal at specific scheduled times (we will tell you the exact date and time in advance)

- Monitor the portal for appointment slots as they are released

- Immediately book an available slot using the client details we provide you

- Fill in applicant information accurately (names, passport numbers, dates — zero typos allowed)

- Confirm the booking and send us proof (screenshot + confirmation details) right away

- Report back promptly if no slots were available during your session



## Schedule



- Part-time and flexible — sessions are short 

- Slot-release times follow India Standard Time (IST), which is only 2.5 hours behind Philippine time, so most sessions fall at reasonable PH hours

- You must be at your computer, logged in, and ready BEFORE the scheduled time — every single time. If you are 5 minutes late, the slots are gone.



## Requirements



- Stable, fast internet connection (please include your speed test result in your application)

- A reliable computer (not just a phone) and backup power/data if possible

- Fast, accurate typing and comfortable navigating web forms

- 100% punctuality and reliability — this job is useless if you show up late

- Available on short notice via [Messenger / WhatsApp /
]



## Pay



- ?3000/$50 per successfully booked appointment

-  small Fixed show-up fee of ?3000/50$ per month even if not available to book the appoinment but put effort so that your time is rewarded. But pay is higher for high performing agent

- Paid via [GCash / Wise / Payoneer] [weekly / twice a month]

- Consistent, reliable performers get more sessions and priority assignments



## How to Apply



To make sure you read this post carefully, start your application with the word **PUNCTUAL** in the first line, then include:



1. A short introduction (2–3 sentences)

2. Your internet speed test result (screenshot from speedtest.net)

3. Your typical daily availability (in Philippine time)

4. One sentence about a time you had to be somewhere/do something at an exact time without fail



Applications that don't follow this format will not be considered.



We're hiring multiple people, so if you're reliable and fast, apply now!

title: Bid Coordinator
description:
Responsibilities



Market & bench building

*Build and continuously expand TriArc’s qualified trade partner database by trade, geography, capacity, and performance.

*Run ongoing prequalification (financials, safety, workload, bonding) in coordination with Accounting.



Bid strategy & scheduling

*Publish the rolling Bid Calendar; align milestones with Estimators/PMs and owners/architects.

*Break down drawings/specs into clear trade packages; assign scope sheets and alternates.



ITB execution

*Prepare Invitation to Bid packages (drawings, specs, addenda, bid forms, alternates, due dates, delivery method).

*Post to BuildingConnected; segment targeted lists; personalize top-tier outreach.



Relentless follow-up

*3-touch cadence (Day 1
 + Day 3 call/text + Day 5 confirmation) and pre-deadline “nudge” to secure commitments.

*Track interest/no-bid reasons; backfill gaps early; escalate risk areas to Estimating.



Bid intake & leveling

*Receive bids, confirm inclusions/exclusions, and level against scope sheets; flag outliers and VE options.

*Package a clean Bid Leveling Matrix for Estimators/PMs with award recommendation.



Data & feedback loops

*Score and rate trade partner performance post-award (price accuracy, quality, safety, schedule).

*Run post-bid debriefs; capture lessons learned to refine future ITBs.



Brand & relationship

*Be TriArc’s front door for subs: fast answers, fair process, respectful communication, and values-based partnership.



Required Traits & Skills

*Excellent Communication Skills

*Hunter mentality: proactive, persistent, upbeat on the phone; comfortable making 30–50 quality contacts/day in peak cycles.

*Construction fluency: understands typical scopes (CSI divisions), alternates, addenda, and gaps that derail bids.

*Process discipline: lives in checklists, documents everything.

*Communication: crisp writing, professional phone presence, tact with hard-bid deadlines.

*Values fit: Do what you say • Do the right thing • Gumption • Stick-to-itiveness • Passion/Enthusiasm.



Nice-to-Have

*Customer Service / Appointment Setting experience

*GC pre-con/bid desk experience or supplier/manufacturer rep background.

*Existing DFW sub network across interiors, ground-up flex/industrial, retail shells.

*Computer: Intel i5 processor or equivalent with at least 8GB RAM

*Internet: Minimum 50 MBPS download speed

*Dual Monitor is required

*Noise cancellation headset

*HD Cam (Clutter Free, Ideally Plain Well-lit background)



Job Details:

Job Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Schedule: Monday to Friday 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM CDT - Monday to Friday 9:30 PM - 5:30 AM PHT

Salary Range: PHP 70,000 – 90,000 monthly, depending on experience.

Fill out the application form:

title: Amazon Marketplace Growth & Global Sourcing Manager (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Amazon Marketplace Growth & Global Sourcing Manager (Full-Time, Remote)



About Us



We are a rapidly growing North American industrial products company expanding our Amazon business.



Our product categories include industrial supplies, warehouse equipment, construction accessories, PPE, abrasives, adhesives, packaging products, material handling equipment, safety products, and related commercial products.



We source products globally and are looking for an experienced Amazon professional to take ownership of our marketplace growth.



**This is NOT a Virtual Assistant position.**



We are looking for someone who has successfully built and managed large Amazon businesses and can independently drive profitable growth.



---



Your Mission



Own and grow our Amazon business by identifying profitable products, sourcing quality manufacturers, launching new products, optimizing listings, managing advertising campaigns, and maximizing profitability.



---



Key Responsibilities



 Amazon Growth Strategy



* Develop and execute a long-term Amazon growth strategy.

* Identify opportunities to expand our product catalog.

* Increase revenue while maintaining strong profit margins.

* Monitor competitors and industry trends.



Product Research & Global Sourcing



* Identify profitable products that align with our business.

* Source manufacturers in China and other overseas markets.

* Negotiate pricing, MOQs, lead times, and payment terms.

* Evaluate suppliers for quality, reliability, and certifications.

* Coordinate samples, testing, and production.



Amazon Listing Management



* Create and optimize Amazon listings.

* Perform keyword research and Amazon SEO.

* Write high-converting titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend keywords.

* Develop A+ Content and Brand Store pages.

* Improve conversion rates through continuous optimization.



Amazon Advertising



* Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and Sponsored Display campaigns.

* Optimize PPC performance.

* Reduce ACOS while maintaining growth.

* Improve TACOS and overall profitability.

* Scale successful advertising campaigns.



Inventory & Operations



* Forecast inventory demand.

* Coordinate FBA shipments.

* Prevent stock-outs and excess inventory.

* Monitor SKU performance and recommend improvements.



Profitability



* Analyze margins for every SKU.

* Recommend pricing strategies.

* Scale winning products.

* Identify and discontinue underperforming products.



---



Minimum Requirements



**Please do not apply unless you meet the following requirements.**



Required Experience



* Personally managed an Amazon Seller Central account generating **at least US$2 million in annual sales.**

* Minimum **5 years** of Amazon marketplace experience.

* Proven success launching and scaling Amazon products.

* Strong experience managing Amazon PPC campaigns.

* Experience sourcing products directly from China and/or other overseas manufacturers.

* Experience working with Amazon FBA.

* Strong knowledge of Amazon SEO and listing optimization.

* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent written and spoken English.



Preferred Experience



Experience selling products in one or more of the following categories:



* Industrial supplies

* Construction products

* PPE (Personal Protective Equipment)

* Safety equipment

* Abrasives

* Adhesives

* Material handling

* Packaging supplies

* Warehouse equipment

* Commercial or B2B products



Software Experience



Experience with some or all of the following:



* Amazon Seller Central

* Helium 10

* Keepa

* Jungle Scout

* DataDive

* Microsoft Excel

* Google Sheets

* Alibaba

* Global Sources



---



Compensation



* Competitive monthly salary based on experience.

* Performance bonuses tied to profitable growth.

* Long-term, full-time opportunity.

* Significant opportunity for career growth as our Amazon business expands.



---



Required With Your Application



Applications that do not answer the following questions will not be considered.



1. What is the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed?

2. What was the annual revenue of that account?

3. How many SKUs did you manage?

4. What were your primary responsibilities?

5. What monthly PPC budget did you manage?

6. What was your average ACOS?

7. What was your average TACOS?

8. How many products have you personally launched?

9. Describe your most successful Amazon product launch.

10. Describe your experience sourcing products from China or other overseas manufacturers.

11. Which Amazon software tools do you use daily?

12. Please provide proof of your experience managing Amazon accounts (screenshots with confidential information hidden are acceptable).



---



What Success Looks Like



Within your first 12 months, you will:



* Launch multiple profitable products.

* Build strong relationships with overseas manufacturers.

* Improve the profitability of our existing catalog.

* Grow Amazon revenue while maintaining healthy margins.

* Develop repeatable systems for sourcing, launching, advertising, and scaling products.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career and become a key leader in our growing e-commerce business.

title: Channel Partner Manager
description:
We are looking for a results-driven, high-energy Channel Partner Manager based in the Philippines to re-ignite and scale our global Channel Partnership Programme. This is a full time, remote role.



Our partnership model is unique and highly attractive: we offer a "Zero Sales Burden" proposition. Your partners do not need to learn complex software demonstrations or close technical deals; their sole focus is identifying opportunities, introducing our platform, and registering qualified leads. Once a lead is registered, our internal sales team takes over to run the demos and close the revenue, while the partner reaps the rewards.



Your mission is to find the right partners, onboard them quickly, and keep them highly engaged so they consistently feed our sales pipeline with high-quality opportunities.



Key Responsibilities

Re-ignite & Scale: Audit our existing partner network, re-engage dormant relationships, and design a structured outreach strategy to recruit new high-potential channel partners.



Partner Enablement & Activation: Equip partners with the simple tools, messaging, and co-marketing materials they need to easily identify leads within their existing networks.



Pipeline & Lead Governance: Actively manage the partner lead registration portal. Review incoming leads to ensure quality, prevent market conflicts, and smoothly hand them off to our internal account executives.



Relationship Management: Serve as the primary, day-to-day point of contact for partners. Run regular check-ins to keep our SaaS top-of-mind and help them overcome any roadblocks.



Performance Tracking: Monitor partner-driven pipeline metrics (lead volume, conversion rates, and partner activity levels) and report directly to leadership on programme health.



Required Qualifications & Experience

SaaS Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of experience specifically managing or scaling a Channel Partnership / Reseller / Referral Programme for a B2B SaaS company.



Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success in driving predictable, high-volume lead registration or indirect revenue growth through third-party partners.



Excellent Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to confidently pitch, negotiate, and build trust with business owners and channel executives globally.



Process & Tool Savvy: Comfortable managing partner portals, CRMs (e.g., HubSpot/Salesforce), and leveraging automation tools to track lead attribution accurately.



Self-Starter Mindset: Experience working remotely for international companies. You are highly organized, comfortable with ambiguity, and capable of executing a partnership strategy with minimal day-to-day supervision.

title: Part-Time Bookkeeper / Accounting Support
description:
About Elite 8 Tax Relief & Business Advisors:

We are a dynamic financial services firm dedicated to providing tailored tax preparation, bookkeeping, and financial services to both individuals and businesses. Our approach is client-centric, ensuring personalized service that meets the unique needs of each client for optimal outcomes. Staying abreast of tax law and financial trends, our expert team is committed to continuous learning and adaptation. Our mission is to empower clients by maintaining their financial health today and proactively planning for their tomorrow.



Role Overview:



Elite 8 Tax Relief & Business Advisors is seeking a highly capable Bookkeeper / Accounting Support Contractor to support client bookkeeping, accounting cleanup, financial reporting, and advisory preparation work. This role is ideal for a self-directed accounting professional who understands bookkeeping is more than data entry. We need someone who can review financial activity, identify issues, communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and help maintain clean, decision-ready books for business clients.

The role involves managing QuickBooks accounts, supporting clients, and contributing to our team's collaborative efforts to meet client needs. The ideal candidate has strong QuickBooks Online and Xero experience, understands accounting fundamentals, can manage client accounts independently, and communicates proactively when questions, issues, or bottlenecks arise. This role requires professional judgment, accountability, and the ability to work with limited supervision.



Primary Responsibilities:



Bookkeeping & Account Management

Maintain accurate books for assigned client accounts.

Categorize transactions properly based on client activity and accounting principles.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, merchant accounts, payroll accounts, and other balance sheet accounts.

Review financial statements for obvious errors, inconsistencies, unusual balances, and missing activity.

Maintain clean, organized, and supportable books for each client.

Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual bookkeeping close processes.

Track outstanding client questions, missing documents, and unresolved transactions.

Support cleanup and catch-up bookkeeping projects when assigned.

Prepare client books for tax preparation, tax planning, or advisory review.



Accounting Review & Quality Control

Identify uncategorized, misclassified, duplicate, or unsupported transactions.

Review balance sheet accounts for reasonableness.

Flag negative loan balances, shareholder distributions, owner draws, retained earnings issues, payroll inconsistencies, and unusual expense activity.

Understand the difference between ordinary expenses, capital assets, loans, equity, distributions, and reimbursements.

Recognize when depreciation, amortization, fixed assets, loan treatment, payroll, or tax-sensitive classifications may require review.

Maintain documentation for bookkeeping decisions and client-provided support.

Escalate technical questions before making unsupported assumptions.



Software & Workflow

Work primarily in QuickBooks Online and Xero.

Use firm-approved project management, document management, and communication tools.

Follow established client workflows, task assignments, naming conventions, and deadlines.

Update task status clearly and consistently.

Document work performed, open issues, assumptions, and pending client needs.

Assist with process improvement when recurring problems are identified.



Client & Team Communication

Communicate clearly in writing and verbally.

Provide concise updates on work status, missing information, and client issues.

Ask focused questions when clarification is needed.

Communicate challenges early enough to protect deadlines.

Provide proposed solutions whenever possible.

Participate in scheduled internal check-ins as needed.

Maintain professionalism and confidentiality at all times.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.

Experience supporting tax firms, accounting firms, or advisory practices.

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field.

Both QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor and Xero Advisor Certifications.

Experience independently managing client bookkeeping accounts.

Strong understanding of GAAP fundamentals.

Experience with multiple business types and industries.

Familiarity with U.S. small business tax concepts.

Familiarity with tax-sensitive bookkeeping concepts, including depreciation, capital assets, loans, payroll, owner equity, and deductible versus nondeductible expenses.

Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Must be able to pass a background check and be bondable due to access to confidential client financial information.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive financial data.



Preferred Qualifications

Have at least two U.S. based references.

Experience preparing books for tax preparation or tax planning.

Payroll bookkeeping experience.

Experience with real estate, medical practices, professional services, construction, cannabis, retail, or service-based businesses.

Experience with cleanup bookkeeping projects.

Experience using workflow tools such as TaxDome, Basecamp, Trello, Asana, Karbon, Financial Cents, or similar platforms.

Experience with document request workflows and client communication tracking.



Technology, Security & Data Protection Requirements

Because this role involves access to confidential client financial records, tax-related documents, bookkeeping systems, and firm information, the contractor must maintain a secure remote work environment and comply with all firm technology and data protection requirements.



The contractor must be able to meet and maintain minimum security standards, including but not limited to:

Reliable high-speed internet connection.

Secure, password-protected computer used for professional work.

Updated operating system and software.

Active anti-malware / antivirus protection.

Properly configured firewall protection.

Use of a firm-approved VPN when required.

Multi-factor authentication for all approved systems.

Secure password management practices.

No shared use of firm logins, client files, or confidential data.

No saving client documents to unauthorized personal devices, drives, or cloud storage.

Compliance with all firm procedures for document access, storage, transmission, and deletion.



The contractor must promptly report any suspected security issue, lost or compromised device, unauthorized access, malware i
, password compromise, or data exposure concern.



Failure to maintain required security standards may result in immediate removal of system access and termination of the contractor relationship.



Background Check, Bondability & Trust Requirements

Because this role involves access to sensitive client financial records, business accounts, tax-related documents, and confidential firm information, candidates must be able to successfully complete a background check and be bondable.

The selected contractor must demonstrate a professional history suitable for handling confidential financial information, client records, bookkeeping systems, and related account access. Any background concern that may affect financial trust, confidentiality, client security, or professional reliability must be disclosed during the screening process.

Candidates must also agree to follow all firm confidentiality, data security, document handling, password management, and client privacy requirements.



Contractor Classification

This is an independent contractor role. The contractor is responsible for managing their own work environment, equipment, internet access, taxes, insurance, and any other obligations associated with independent contractor status. This role does not create an employer-employee relationship.



Application Process

Application Deadline: June 8th 11:59 AM Philippine Standard Time.

Interested candidates should complete our application: 



Elite 8 Tax & Business Advisors is an equal opportunity employer, valuing diversity and committed to creating an inclusive environment.



*Important Note* Please do not directly contact anyone on our team. We are thoroughly reviewing each application and will provide communication to everyone about their status moving forward.

Multi-entity accounting

Consolidations

Intercompany transactions

Financial statement design

multi-location business experience

Number of Sage Intacct implementations completed
